domain: The search for a coherent concept of 'burnout' as a diagnosable condition, and whether it names a real psychological kind at all
topic: The search for a coherent concept of 'burnout' as a diagnosable condition, and whether it names a real psychological kind at all

source.title: How to do less for your children

movement.gist: Introduce burnout as apparently settled: named by Freudenberger in the 1970s, now in the WHO's ICD-11 as an 'occupational phenomenon,' with a validated inventory (exhaustion, cynicism, reduced efficacy) used worldwide in surveys and HR policy — a stable, measurable clinical object.

First criterion fails: the exhaustion/cynicism/efficacy triad, meant to distinguish burnout from depression, turns out to correlate so heavily with depressive symptoms in factor analyses that researchers cannot agree whether burnout is a distinct construct or depression rebranded for the workplace.

Second criterion fails: the WHO explicitly excludes burnout as a medical diagnosis (it's a 'phenomenon,' not a disease) while clinics, insurers, and sick-leave systems in several countries quietly treat it as one anyway — so the thing that supposedly stabilizes the concept (official classification) is itself internally split.

Hinge: what looked like two separate criteria failing for two separate reasons turns out to be one pattern — every operational definition of burnout smuggles in a prior judgment about which kinds of suffering are 'legitimately' work-caused, so the inventory isn't measuring a natural kind but encoding a social bargain about whose exhaustion counts.

Dissolution: burnout is not a hidden syndrome awaiting a sharper instrument, nor a fiction to be debunked — it is the name for a negotiation, and asking 'is it real' presupposes a fact of the matter that the negotiation was never trying to produce.

primary.axis: burnout as a discrete clinical entity vs. burnout as a label draped over ordinary exhaustion
poles: a specific syndrome with its own mechanism and course
a folk category assembled after the fact from whatever symptoms felt nameable

secondary.axis: the diagnostic gaze vs. the thing it examines
poles: burnout as object awaiting better instruments
burnout as an artifact produced by the instruments used to look for it

tension_system.interaction: the secondary tension supplies the mechanism by which the primary one collapses: every attempt to sharpen the instrument turns out to have been drawing the boundary it claimed to discover

family_realization.note: Passage executes 'Vanishing Object' precisely. Burnout appears fixed (paragraph 1: 'origin story, instrument, classification'), then progressively dissolves. Paragraph 2 shows measurement fails to separate burnout from depression. Paragraph 3 reveals classification itself is split ('not a medical condition' vs. active clinical use). Paragraph 4 reframes the entire apparatus: 'Each operational definition of burnout begins by deciding which suffering is chargeable to the employer'—the object was never clinical, always contractual. Final paragraph confirms dissolution: instruments 'were never lenses...drew the line it claimed to find.' The thesis is indeed a redescription (burnout as settlement, not syndrome), not a position on original question.

ending_behavior.note: Closing performs 'Instrument Doubt' with aperture-widening. Final sentence questions the analytic tools passage used ('sharpening instruments were never lenses'). The stance is refusal-dissolved: 'the exhausted lose a word that made their claim legible; what they keep is the argument the word was standing in for, which was always the harder thing to win.' Opens outward to the unsettled underlying claim rather than resolving.

voice_consistency.note: 'Moral Accountant' tally throughout: paragraph 4 itemizes what each party owes ('which suffering is chargeable to the employer'). Quiet indignation present ('the honest cost of saying so'). Concrete particular: the nurse vs. caregiving daughter contrast stays tactile. Uneven polish: 'It looks like an administrative gap' (conversational) against more formal clauses. Not every sentence epigrammatic; prose breathes naturally.

distractor_efficiency.note: Q1(B): premature_closure trap—plausible extension of measurement logic passage dismantles. Q2(C): false_symmetry—seductive because border metaphor suggests two equals competing. Q3(C): half_truth trap—paragraph does name coordination idea before overturning it. Q4(A): category_slip—misreads clinical equivalence as the point; actually contractual criterion is. Q5(A): false_symmetry—sounds like nuanced balance but passage denies paired distortion. Q6(B): false_symmetry—sounds reasonable (both parties benefit) but contradicts passage's prior-settlement claim.

explanation_quality.note: Every elimination names mechanism with passage location. Q1(B): 'last paragraph denies...any revised inventory could settle.' Q2(B): quotes the border-metaphor logic directly. Q3(D): locates the 'easier to read' phrasing and paragraph 4's reinterpretation. Q4(B): ties nurse-daughter contrast to contractual-criterion argument. Q5(D): quotes the immediate following clause fixing the metaphor. Q6(A): quotes closing sentence's 'honest cost' as evidence of sympathy with refusal.

answers.reasoning: Passage argues instruments encode a prior contractual settlement, not discover a syndrome.
A border dispute requires both sides to have independently specified boundaries; only depression does.
Paragraph three's 'administrative gap' reading is explicitly overturned in paragraph four.
The argument requires that employer-based scope implies no genuine clinical kind is tracked.
Directly restates the thesis: refinement draws boundaries rather than revealing a pre-existing object.
Final paragraph says exhausted lose a legible word but keep the harder underlying argument.
